parsed.strategy: Bet on liquid global quality-momentum: names with strong 6-12 month momentum (mom_252_21) and either improving gross margin or unanimous analyst raise flow, concentrated in AI semis, power/grid, biotech PDUFAs and enterprise software. Every holding has a dated Q3 print or FDA decision inside Oct 12-Nov 13 or shortly after, so relative P&L is driven by real events. I would be wrong if a single AI-capex digestion headline hits the semis/power sleeve simultaneously, or if the biotech PDUFA cluster produces CRLs that overwhelm the software and industrial winners.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L vs Bloomberg WLS index, 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13, long-only global quality-momentum book.

strategy.brief: Quality momentum: liquid names with strong 6-12 month momentum (mom_252_21) AND improving gross margin; avoid names far above their 200-day with falling margins. Competition rules: long only, global, <= 10% per name, >= 8 names, NO ETFs, cash <= 2%, graded as relative P&L vs the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13.
